name: John Archibald Wheeler
summary: American theoretical physicist known for contributions to general relativity, nuclear physics, and quantum mechanics.

name: Charles W. Misner
summary: American physicist and Wheeler's Ph.D. student, later professor at University of Maryland.

name: Joseph Weber
summary: American physicist who became founding father of gravitational wave detection efforts.

name: Peter Putnam
summary: Wheeler's graduate student who later organized a book of letters to Wheeler.

name: Hugh Everett III
summary: Wheeler's Ph.D. student known for many-worlds interpretation of quantum mechanics.

name: Tullio Regge
summary: Italian physicist who collaborated with Wheeler on perturbation technology for Schwarzschild metric.

name: Princeton University
summary: American university where Wheeler taught general relativity starting in 1952.

name: Leiden University
summary: Dutch university where Wheeler served as Lorentz Professor in 1956.

aliases: Institute for Advanced Study in Princeton
